=== Systemd Orchestration Refactoring

*Status*: ✅ Completed +
*Start Date*: 2026-02-08 +
*Completion Date*: 2026-02-08

Comprehensive refactoring of the RKE2Lab systemd unit architecture to simplify dependencies, standardize naming, and integrate readiness checks.

*Documents*:

* link:sow-systemd-refactoring.adoc[Project Statement of Work]
* link:phase1-inventory.adoc[Phase 1: Inventory & Mapping]
* link:phase2-naming-refactor.adoc[Phase 2: Naming Refactor]
* link:phase3-readiness-integration.adoc[Phase 3: Readiness Integration & Simplification]

*Key Results*:

* Renamed 13 systemd units to standardized naming convention
* Eliminated 11 redundant files (5 ready services + 6 targets)
* Integrated readiness checks into manifests services using ExecStartPost
* Simplified from target-based to direct service dependencies
* Net reduction: 148 lines of code across 30 files

== Working Practices

=== Remote Execution Convention

All commands targeting the NixOS VM and Incus nodes use this pattern:

[source,bash]
----
ssh <host>-nixos.local -- incus exec <node> -- flox activate --dir=/var/lib/rancher/rke2 -- <cmd>
----

Example:
[source,bash]
----
ssh bioskop-nixos.local -- incus exec master -- systemctl status rke2lab-mesh-manifests.service
----

=== Kubeconfig Location

The cluster kubeconfig is located at:

[source,bash]
----
/srv/host/kubeconfig.d/rke2-${RKE2LAB_CLUSTER_NAME}.yaml
----

For the default `bioskop` cluster:
[source,bash]
----
/srv/host/kubeconfig.d/rke2-bioskop.yaml
----

This is configured in link:../../make.d/incus/targets.mk[make.d/incus/targets.mk]:

* `RKE2LAB_KUBECONFIG_DIR=/srv/host/kubeconfig.d`
* `RKE2LAB_CLUSTER_NAME=$(CLUSTER_NAME)` (defaults to `bioskop`)

The kubeconfig is generated by link:../../make.d/incus/scripts/rke2lab-vip-kubeconfig.sh[rke2lab-vip-kubeconfig.sh] and configured to connect via the VIP address.

=== Host Orchestration

On the NixOS VM, activate flox before orchestration:
[source,bash]
----
ssh <host>-nixos.local -- flox activate --dir=/var/lib/git/nxmatic/rke2lab -- <cmd>
----

Always use `remake` (not `make`) for deployment orchestration.

=== Git Workflow

* Use `git mv` for renames (preserves history)
* Use `git rm` for deletions
* Stage changes logically by phase
* Descriptive commit messages referencing SOW/phase documents
